page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin beside the first lines. Running head at the top, page number above it. The catchword stands at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: si nondum extante i-psius huma-nitate, pa-tribus ta-men totus, & in sim-plici verbo, & in vete-ribus Sa-cramentis, fuit spiri-tualiter re-praesenta-tus.nem, neque in veteris Testamenti simplici verbo, nec in umbris illis (quarum tamen iam tum Christus corpus erat) nec in veteribus Sacramentis, ea quam hi requirunt inexisten-tia vel indistantia, praeberi patribus illis po-tuisse, corporeis organis sumendum: non mo-do ea qua hi monetur ratione, quia nimirum Christi humanitas in rerum natura nondum erat: verum etiam in primis, quoniam talis praebitio nihil ad Sacramentorum usum & finem, utpote spiritualem, facit, ideoque, ne nunc quidem requiritur. Sed inde colligi debuisse nego, Christum etiam secundum carnem, licet nondum creatam, menti & fidei patrum non fuisse verissimè & efficacissimè, tum in simplici verbo, tum in umbris illis, tum in Sacramentis repraesentatum. Hoc e-nim qui negat, Christi quoque personam, in fidei patrum mysterio, dividit: negat patres, eundem atque nos, (non certè signis, sed quòd ad generalem Sacramenti definitionem & conditionem attinet) cibum ac potum spiritualem habuisse: negat Petram illam spiritua-lem, (id est, non qualis erat sui natura, sed quatenus Sacramentum erat) fuisse Sacramentaliter Christum ipsum, & quidem totum ac θεάνθρωπον[?]. Hoc tamen Paulus expressis verbis affirmat, & nisi illud agnoscamus, consequetur Christum fuisse patribus sola Deitate Mediatorem, ac proinde aliam reipsa fuisse patrum fidem, & Ecclesiam, quàm nostram: Christum adhuc venturum, à Christo exhibito eo

page.notes: Long s read as plain s throughout. Uncertain: the Greek word "θεάνθρωπον" is printed as "ϑεάνθρωπον" and the scan is faint, so it is marked [?]. The margin note's first word reads "si" (long s, printed "fi"). In the margin, "pfius" is read as "ipsius" from the hyphenated line break "i-psius". Printed "Mediatorem,ac" has a comma and no space; kept as "Mediatorem, ac". The catchword "to eo" is at the lower right and is kept out of the text.
